data.long_meaning: The name Roseann is derived from the English word 'rose', which refers to the beautiful flower. The name is a feminine variation of the name Roscoe, which means 'rose' in old English. The name Roseann symbolizes grace, beauty, and the delicate strength of a rose. In Christianity, the rose is a symbol of the Virgin Mary, as well as the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
